### Extend UI Kit


React components for document apps


PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and CSV viewers, bounding box citations, file upload, and e-signature. Add components to your codebase from a shadcn registry and restyle them like your own.


- 15 components
- shadcn registry
- MIT


Add the PDF viewer


```text
$  npx shadcn@latest add https://www.extend.ai/ui/r/styles/new-york/pdf-viewer.json
```


[Browse components](https://www.extend.ai/ui)[GitHub](https://github.com/extend-hq/ui)

Ready-made pipelines for 50+ document types

### Extend MCP


Document tools for any MCP client


One hosted server gives Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, and any MCP client tools to parse, extract, classify, split, and edit documents. Sign in with OAuth, nothing to install.


- 86 tools
- 9 tool groups
- OAuth


Server URL


```text
https://mcp.extend.ai/mcp
```


[Connect your client](https://www.extend.ai/agents/mcp)[Docs](https://docs.extend.ai/mcp)

### Extend CLI


Document processing from the shell


Parse, extract, classify, split, and edit documents with one command. The setup wizard signs you in and installs a skill, so coding agents can drive the CLI too.


- Homebrew, npm, Go
- Agent skill included
- MIT


Install and sign in


```text
$  curl -fsSL https://extend.ai/install.sh | sh && extend setup
```


[Install CLI](https://www.extend.ai/agents/cli)[GitHub](https://github.com/extend-hq/extend-cli)

### Extend SDK


Typed API clients for your stack


Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go clients for parse, extract, classify, split, and edit, with polling and webhook helpers. Add the extend-api skill and your coding agent writes the integration for you.


- Python, TypeScript, Java, Go
- extend-api skill
- MIT


```text
$  pip install extend-ai
```


```text
$  npm install extend-ai
```


```text
$  go get github.com/extend-hq/extend-go-sdk
```


```text
$  npx skills add extend-hq/extend-agent-plugin --skill extend-api
```


[Set up the SDK](https://www.extend.ai/agents/sdk)[Docs](https://docs.extend.ai/sdks)
